partial-fractions-split.alt: Graph of y = (x + 7)/((x − 1)(x + 3)), solid green, with dashed vertical asymptotes at x = 1 and x = −3, and its two pieces dashed: y = 2/(x − 1) in blue and y = −1/(x + 3) in vermillion. At every x the green curve is the sum of the two pieces, so its integral is 2 ln|x − 1| − ln|x + 3| + C.
